news_summary: At least 57 Indian American candidates are on the November 3 midterm ballot, including four House incumbents rated Solid D and open-seat candidates Amish Shah in Arizona and Pia Dandiya in Florida.
payoff: Wins for both Shah and Dandiya would hold the 'Samosa Caucus' at six.
